description: This file defines an interface 'IFatalErrorHandler' for handling fatal errors within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for identifying unexpected exceptions and for handling fatal exception events.

classes.name: IFatalErrorHandler
classes.description: Interface for controlling how fatal errors are handled in Orleans runtime, providing methods to identify unexpected exceptions and respond to fatal errors.

methods.name: IsUnexpected
methods.description: Determines whether the provided exception is considered unexpected.

methods.name: OnFatalException
methods.description: Handles a fatal exception event, with optional sender, context, and exception parameters.
